I called your customer care and was assisted by someone named Sanjana—without a doubt, the most unprofessional and unhelpful experience I’ve had with any brand. She had no active listening skills, showed zero empathy, and gave me an invalid store contact number. I’ve since spent a frustrating amount of time trying to reach the store manager, with no success. Calls get dropped or ignored, and no one takes accountability.

This kind of treatment towards paying, loyal customers is completely unacceptable. If this is the standard Pantaloons is setting, it's deeply disappointing. Your team leaves customers hanging and adds stress instead of solving problems.

I hope this review is taken seriously and that immediate steps are taken to improve customer service—starting with better training and accountability.
